text: The presence of leukocyturia and binucleated eosinophils despite a negative bacterial culture is highly suggestive of Churg-Strauss syndrome (EGPA) or severe eosinophilic pyelonephritis rather than typical bacterial infection. Given your recent sinusitis, have you experienced episodes of asthma or allergic reactions in the past? REQUEST TEST: Serum_Eosinophil_Count; REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_ULtrasound.
